_comment: When each shipped data file was actually captured from its source. Recorded explicitly because a file's modification time resets whenever it is copied, which made the app report the day it was deployed as the day the slate was pulled. UPDATE THESE WHEN YOU REFRESH A FILE -- the header showed Week 1 dates against a Week 2 slate because this was forgotten once.

slate.note: 671 players, 13 games, all Sunday 9/27 1:00-4:25pm — one clean main slate with no primetime to filter. Statuses at the pull: 557 active, 62 IR, 15 out, 37 questionable.

contests.source: DraftKings lobby, hand-transcribed from 3 screenshots, Classic at $50 and under
contests.note: 14 contests. The three Red Zone single-entries are the lowest-rake on the board at 12.0% but have no payout grid, so they are unknown and unplayable until one is captured.

variance.note: Each player's own scoring spread. 359 of 670 matched on the Week 2 slate; the rest fall back to a flat positional multiple and are labelled inferred.

prior.note: 578 players. Flat 2025 average, blended against the in-season average at n/(n+3) so a single Week 1 game cannot carry a projection.

kalshi.source: Kalshi public read API, player prop ladders
kalshi.note: 150 of 671 DK players matched exactly. Not used by the projection -- forward validation only, because no historical Kalshi data exists to backtest against. Passing-TD and anytime-TD markets returned nothing at this capture.

usage.note: 431 players. Last game's snap share and touches. 373 players' latest game is week 2; 25 are week 3 (Thursday night, not on this slate); 33 are still week 1 and are therefore two weeks stale — `games` and `week` are published per player so that is visible rather than hidden.
